ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #18
====

GRADE: Grade 2
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Transporting? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Transporting.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Transporting.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Transporting.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Transporting.

2. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   B. Burning crop residue every week
   C. Removing all vegetation
   D. Overgrazing continuously

3. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   B. A mixture of two liquids
   C. Any white crystal used in cooking
   D. Any substance that conducts electricity

4. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. joule (J)
   B. pascal (Pa)
   C. watt (W)
   D. newton (N)

5. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   B. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   C. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   D. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Soil and its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Soil and its resources.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Soil and its resources.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Soil and its resources.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Soil and its resources.

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Safety when handling? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Safety when handling.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Safety when handling.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Safety when handling.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Safety when handling.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Animals resources? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Animals resources.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Animals resources.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Animals resources.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Animals resources.

9. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water removes heat too quickly
   B. Water always increases oxygen
   C. Petrol fires have no fuel
   D. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

10. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 37 °C
   B. 100 °C
   C. 50 °C
   D. 0 °C

11. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Tertiary consumers
   B. Producers
   C. Primary consumers only
   D. Decomposers only

12. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Paper burning to ash
   B. Iron rusting
   C. Ice melting to water
   D. Milk souring

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Energy: Light its resources and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Forming shadows in light and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Precautions when using and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain School environment environment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:

2. A — Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

3. A — A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

5. C — Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio

6. B — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Soil and its resources.

7. C — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Safety when handling.

8. B — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Animals resources.

9. D — Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

10. B — 100 °C

11. B — Producers

12. C — Ice melting to water
